artifacts.content:
# Impact Planner Rebound Verification

Outcome: pass

## Context and lineage

Verified all 26 declared repository context files against their exact raw SHA-256 digests and byte counts before use. No mismatches were found.

Verified the revision-3 predecessor as revision-2 run `run.v14.impact-planner.medium.r2` with terminal outcome `fix`, failure class `stale_context_identity`, and evidence digest matching the exact revision-2 review-attempt-2 bytes. The graph-recovery and integration handoffs matched the predecessor raw digests, declared agent IDs, revision-2 goal identity, common compilation digest `sha256:8843d3af923c5fc16327ab9face168bc4f175314ab778ee71cd6d8e520567880`, and `pass` outcomes. The review handoff matched the listed raw digest, revision-2 goal and compilation bindings, and verified `fix` outcome. The revision-1 codec and interface handoffs also retained matching goal and compilation lineage. The revision-3 contract compilation and blueprint bindings matched the approved values used by this handoff.

## Automated verification

`npm.cmd test` passed 22 of 22 tests with 0 failures across codec, graph, storage, interface, integration, and server suites.

`npm.cmd run check` passed syntax checks for `server.mjs`, `src/app.js`, `src/codec.js`, `src/graph.js`, `src/storage.js`, `src/ui-policy.js`, and `src/view.js`.

A bounded static security scan found no application `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `eval`, `document.write`, `innerHTML`, dynamic import, or external URL usage. The only URL matches were the server's expected loopback URL construction and startup message. Server tests passed the declared asset allowlist, closed CSP, method boundaries, traversal protection, and loopback binding checks.

## Browser verification

Using the delivered browser skill against `http://127.0.0.1:4175/`, desktop verification at 1440 by 900 observed the seeded four-component workspace, one changed component, four affected components, score 13, deterministic dependency paths, semantic regions, labeled form controls, and accessible component actions.

Selecting Public API immediately produced two changed components, score 16, and the announcement `Public API added to the change set.` Adding Search Service with dependency `api` produced five components, preserved `Depends on: api`, announced success, cleared the form, restored focus to `component-id`, and persisted across reload with score 19.

Mobile verification at 390 by 844 retained the core workspace and affected-component content, showed no horizontal document overflow, kept form and change-list bounds within the viewport, and measured Import, Export, and Reset controls at 44 pixels high. Reset activation surfaced the required confirmation dialog; a browser-control timeout occurred while attempting the optional acceptance step, so no reset-completion claim is made. A fresh tab remained responsive and preserved the tested workspace. Console inspection on both the interactive and fresh tabs returned no warnings or errors.

No repository, test, workflow, evidence, memory, dependency, or Git files were modified.
